title: Copper Wire Tables (National Bureau of Standards Handbook 100)
authors: Office of Engineering Standards, Institute for Applied Technology, U.S. National Bureau of Standards
publisher: U.S. National Bureau of Standards; official archive hosted by NIST
reviewed_sections: Printed p.3 / PDF p.9: IACS resistivity and temperature coefficient
Printed p.40 / PDF p.46: resistivity definitions and standard annealed copper
limitations: Selected pages read and visually checked, not the full handbook. Historical material/resistivity reference for standard annealed copper, not PCB ampacity, electrodeposited foil qualification or a thermal model. Real material and operating temperature must be established separately.
evidence: Official NIST PDF inspected as text and rendered pages. Printed p.3 gives 1.7241 microohm-cm at 20 C; printed p.40 defines volume resistivity as resistance times area divided by length. No wire ampacity table is transferred to PCB traces.
